name: lint_run
description: Run installed query linters (gofmt -l, go vet, ruff/flake8, eslint, shellcheck) and parse findings

path.description: directory or file to lint (default: project root)

tools.description: restrict to these tools: gofmt, go vet, ruff, flake8, eslint, shellcheck (default: all present)

limit.description: findings to return, sorted by file/line (default 300)
